# ICSI — Authorization Guide

**Subtitle:** CPT Codes · ICD-10 · Payer Requirements

_backHref: /icsi_

## CPT Codes

| CPT | Description | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 89280 | Assisted oocyte fertilization, microtechnique; ≤10 oocytes | ICSI ≤10 |
| 89281 | Assisted oocyte fertilization, microtechnique; >10 oocytes | ICSI >10 |
| 89260 | Sperm isolation; simple prep (sperm wash and swim-up) | Lab |
| 89261 | Sperm isolation; complex prep (Percoll gradient, albumin gradient) | Lab |
| 89264 | Sperm identification from testis tissue, fresh or cryopreserved | Lab — TESE sperm |
| 89257 | Sperm identification from aspiration (other than seminal fluid) | Lab — PESA sperm |

## ICD-10 Diagnoses

| ICD-10 | Description |
| --- | --- |
| N46.01 | Organic azoospermia |
| N46.11 | Organic oligospermia |
| N46.021 | Azoospermia due to obstructive causes |
| N97.9 | Female infertility, unspecified |
| Z31.83 | Encounter for assisted reproductive fertility procedure cycle |
| Z31.81 | Encounter for male factor infertility in female patient |

## Coverage Landscape

### Common Denial Reasons
- Denied as "add-on" to IVF without separate indication
- "Not medically necessary" for non-male factor IVF
- CPT 89280/89281 denied as bundled with egg retrieval (58970)

### Strongest Coverage Arguments
- Absolute indication: azoospermia, surgically retrieved sperm, prior fertilization failure
- ICSI is the only method to achieve fertilization with surgically retrieved sperm
- CPT 89280/89281 are distinct services from egg retrieval (58970) — not bundled per AMA CPT
- Document specific indication in letter of medical necessity

## Prior Authorization Requirements

### Required Documentation
- Semen analysis results (concentration, motility, morphology, TMC)
- Specific ICSI indication documented (absolute vs relative)
- Prior IVF cycle results if applicable (fertilization rate)
- Antisperm antibody testing results if applicable
- Letter of medical necessity from REI specialist
